children: Genius partners with bSTOCKS to bring tokenized securities trading to its platform. Eligible users in supported non-US regions can trade tokenized equities such as AAPLB and SPCXB directly on-chain, with access available around the clock rather than limited to traditional market hours.

The integration adds a new activity driver for GENIUS, since tokenized equity trading gives users a reason to transact on the platform outside standard stock market sessions. Continuous availability is the practical differentiator here, as on-chain settlement removes the opening and closing windows that constrain conventional brokerage access. The offering is geographically limited, so adoption depends on how many supported non-US regions qualify and how actively those users trade the listed securities. Fee generation from this activity is the metric to watch going forward.
